clips.title: The story
paras: Lieutenant Haggerdin is a dwarven officer stationed upon the Headland in the Alterac Mountains. Standing watch outside the fortified gate to Alterac Valley, he acts as the primary recruitment and liaison officer for the Stormpike Guard. He evaluates aspiring Alliance champions and rewards those who prove their valor against the Frostwolf Clan.

Perched in the snowy heights of the Headland above the Hillsbrad Foothills, Lieutenant Haggerdin oversees the muster point for the Alliance's ongoing campaign in Alterac Valley. Dwarven banners flutter beside the massive wooden gate as recruits and veterans assemble under his watchful eye, preparing to plunge into the frigid warzone.

Serving the Stormpike Expedition, Haggerdin ensures that only tested warriors represent Ironforge and the Grand Alliance in the valley. Through challenges like the Proving Grounds, he tasks recruits with recovering banners and relics, and bestows official commendations, insignias, and rank recognitions as soldiers rise through the ranks of the Stormpike Guard.
